title: GTA 6 breaks records on Netflix and reveals gameplay, vehicles, and online mode details
summary: The exclusive GTA 6 trailer on Netflix becomes the platform's biggest launch, while Rockstar confirms more vehicles than GTA 5, removes criticized features, and launches its official roleplay server.

title: CD Projekt confirms free The Witcher 3 Remaster for owners and advances The Witcher 4 without disc version
summary: The Polish studio rules out charging for The Witcher 3 remaster, reveals that the Songs of the Past expansion arose by accident, and hints that The Witcher 4 will prioritize collectible physical content over discs.

title: Double Fine makes Brütal Legend 2 conditional on a $100 million Kickstarter campaign
summary: Tim Schafer and Double Fine promise the sequel to the action-music classic only if fans fund a near-impossible goal, generating skepticism and calls for a millionaire patron.

title: Star Wars Zero Company launches successfully but its studio lays off most of the team before release
summary: The Star Wars tactical game becomes a bestseller on Steam while Bit Reactor lays off much of its staff, leaving developers unpaid according to reports.

title: Nvidia launches DLSS 5 with high performance cost and AI filters that divide critics
summary: The new DLSS version arrives with NBA 2K27 reducing frame rates by up to 60% in exchange for a visual improvement that some call 'yassification' and others impressive.

title: Xbox Game Pass adds RuneScape and SpeedRunners 2 in September but starts slow in 2026
summary: The service adds seven new titles and loses Cyberpunk 2077, while Microsoft offers $5 for buying Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and the industry debates its viability.

title: Sony to pay $8 million in class action settlement over digital game prices on PlayStation Store
summary: A class action lawsuit forces Sony to compensate users for alleged anticompetitive practices in digital game pricing, while the company argues consumers know they don't 'own' their games.

title: PlayStation argues 'reasonable consumers' already know they don't own their digital games
summary: Amid the legal battle over digital ownership, Sony maintains users understand they are buying licenses, not games, while consumer groups decry an erosion of rights.

title: No Rest for the Wicked delays 1.0 launch to March 2027 to polish the Action-RPG
summary: The promised Diablo competitor postpones its final version by nearly a year and a half, citing the need for more time to reach the expected quality level.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 coming to Switch 2 and extends beta with double XP
summary: Activision confirms the new CoD on Nintendo's console, expands beta access, and Microsoft incentivizes purchase with $5 Xbox credit.

title: Brian Ward resigns as CEO of Savvy Games Group, the $38 billion Saudi fund owner of Pokémon Go
summary: The executive steps down after overseeing multi-million dollar mobile acquisitions, generating uncertainty about the strategy of the Middle East's largest gaming investor.

title: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe receives 4.0 update with improvements for Nintendo Switch 2
summary: Nintendo releases a free update adding support for the new console, graphical improvements, and gameplay tweaks, while fans await a Mario Kart 9.

title: Peter Cullen bids farewell to Optimus Prime in new Transformers movie and short
summary: The legendary voice actor confirms his final portrayal of the Autobot leader in a feature film and a short film set to premiere in theaters.

title: Creative Assembly rules out sequels for Total War: Warhammer 40,000 and will focus on expanding the sandbox
summary: The studio states the galaxy is too large to fill with sequels and plans continuous updates to deepen the sandbox experience.

title: Ace Combat 8 to include online air base lobbies to create your own pilot
summary: Bandai Namco showcases multiplayer features of the new air combat simulator, highlighting customization and social interaction in virtual hangars.

title: Doom: The Dark Ages developers denounce 'worst crunch in history' with 17-hour workdays
summary: Former id Software employees reveal extreme conditions during the creation of the Revelations DLC, including family separation and physical exhaustion.

title: Don't Nod announces 'transformation initiative' and faces new layoffs after Life is Strange
summary: The French studio, also responsible for Aphelion, acknowledges financial difficulties and restructures as the industry suffers a wave of cuts.

title: Dwarf Fortress creator warns that AI and 'psychotic' CEOs are destroying the industry
summary: Tarn Adams criticizes forced AI use by executives, defends human narratives, and suggests abolishing dwarven police as a metaphor for equality.

title: Orbitals acclaimed as one of the best co-op games of the year on Switch 2
summary: Reviews highlight the innovative gravity gameplay and team fun of the Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive title.

title: Capcom presents its Tokyo Game Show 2026 lineup with own Spotlight
summary: The Japanese company reveals its plans for the show, including news on Onimusha, Street Fighter, and other unannounced titles.

title: Nintendo adds Ninja Gaiden III, R.C. Pro-Am II, and Ikari Warriors to its NES catalog on Switch Online
summary: The subscription service expands its retro library with three 8-bit era classics, available to subscribers.

title: Afterworld, Paradox's new post-apocalyptic grand strategy, lets you conquer Florida with cannibal mutants
summary: The Swedish studio showcases a playthrough leading a faction of mutant alcoholics, demonstrating the depth and freedom of its strategic sandbox.

title: CD Projekt admits launching Cyberpunk 2077 in poor state 'was a sure mistake' due to internal pressure
summary: The CEO acknowledges the team wanted to get the game 'out the door' despite problems, as details emerge about mandatory crunch.
